text:
Predicates:
MountainRange(x) ::: x is a mountain range.
Located(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Visited(x, y) ::: x visited y.
Donated(x) ::: x has been donated.
Mine(x) ::: x is a mine.
Premises:
(MountainRange(picuris) ∧ (NewMexico(picuris) ∨ Texas(picuris))) ::: The Picuris Mountains are a mountain range in New Mexico or Texas.
Visited(juanDeOnate, picuris) ::: Juan de Onate visited the Picuris Mountains.
(Mine(hardingPegmatiteMine) ∧ Located(hardingPegmatiteMine, picuris) ∧ Donated(hardingPegmatiteMine)) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine, located in the Picuris Mountains, was donated.
∀x (Texas(x) → ¬∃y (Mine(y) ∧ Located(y, x) ∧ Donated(y))) ::: There are no mountain ranges in texas that have mines which have been donated.
Conclusion:
Texas(picuris) ∧ Visited(juanDeOnate, picuris) ::: Juan de Onate visited a mountain range in Texas.
